connector.name: Openqr
connector.registryDescription: Generate QR codes; create, edit & track dynamic QR codes with scan analytics. Free, no watermark.
connector.summary: Hosted at openqr.uk over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the sam-moreton account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer API key from https://openqr.uk/api — format: 'Bearer oqr_...'
